CampBuddy · Promo Reels

5 reel ideas, real app screens ke saath

Ab captions ke peeche flat color nahi, CampBuddy ke asli live screens hain (campbuddy.club se), halki zoom-motion ke saath. Neeche phone-mockups khud chalte hain; screen record karo, "Awaaz on" se Hindi mein khud bol kar sunata hai. Har phone ke saath poora scene-by-scene script bhi hai.

Tip: Phone ko vertical hi record karna. "Awaaz on" ek time pe sirf ek hi phone mein karna. Ye browser ki built-in Hindi awaaz hai (robotic sunegi) — behtar version ke liye AI voice generate karke isi silent MP4 ke upar laga do (exact timestamps `scripts.md` / `.srt` files mein hain).
Brand colours aur logo asli app se; feature screens campbuddy.club (WordCamp Sylhet 2026) ke live, public pages ke real screenshots hain.
